Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261012191715/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t84078.html Internet Archive], [https://web.archive.org/web/20261022024826/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/p1419629.html Internet Archive]</ref>]]
'''Chris Kelly''' (GEMP handle '''chriskelly''')<ref name="roster">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=81218 SWCCG Teams - Rosters], Joe Olson (21 July 2022; spreadsheet updated 14 September 2025). [[:File:SWCCG Teams Rosters 14 September 2025.txt]]; [https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1sm2eRljZ3MNMBMPCJpADTFzFXbuy5jjfVrTb9BCzBC4/edit Google Sheet]; Wayback [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008235350/https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1sm2eRljZ3MNMBMPCJpADTFzFXbuy5jjfVrTb9BCzBC4/edit?usp=sharing 8 October 2026]</ref> is listed as '''[[Design Advocate]]''' on public Players Committee organization charts, with forum handle '''chriskelly'''.<ref name="orgchart2021">PC Organization Chart PDF, CreationDate 8 July 2021; [https://web.archive.org/web/20211005193353/https://res.starwarsccg.org/orgchart/orgchart.pdf Wayback 5 October 2021]</ref><ref name="orgchart2024">PC Organization Chart PDF, CreationDate 6 May 2024; [https://res.starwarsccg.org/orgchart/orgchart.pdf live orgchart.pdf]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261010210152/https://res.starwarsccg.org/orgchart/orgchart.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>

He finished '''#9''' at the [[2025 Morristown Melee]].<ref name="pc-2025MorristownMelee" /> Kelly also finished '''#10''' at the [[2026 Tenth Annual GEMPC]] (lost Round of 16; Challonge seed 13).
